source_snapshot.criteria: Host prerequisites/software install without error and DPU Device ID matches SPEC.

old_problem: The host package transaction lacked pinned signed repository/package identities, OS/kernel compatibility, DPU identity/SPEC and package/network rollback, while DeepSeek incorrectly treated BFB flashing and reboot as intrinsic coverage and proposed truncated/insecure evidence.
disposition_reason: NVIDIA's DOCA Installation Guide explicitly separates DOCA-Host installation from BF-Bundle deployment on the BlueField device. The Master only installs host packages and checks MST identity, so the historical scope conflict is reconciled by prohibiting BFB/firmware changes here. ED-03 permits versions and Device ID SPEC as project bindings; ED-07 requires any future flash to remain separately authorized.

Checked the current NVIDIA DOCA Installation Guide, which lists separate DOCA-Host installation/upgrade and BF-Bundle installation/upgrade on the BlueField device.

Retained every named host package/dependency, the `mst start`/complete `mst status -v` check, 15-minute allocations and Device ID-to-SPEC comparison; optional insecure `sshpass` installation is not automatically authorized.
Directly read next formal queue Compatibility row384 and verified its manifest identity; no package install, reboot, flash or DUT action ran.

test_case.test_name: Version-locked DOCA-Host installation and BlueField MST identity
test_case.purpose: Install the approved DOCA host repository, runtime, SDK, tools and allowlisted dependencies on the compatible host, then prove the intended BlueField DPU is enumerated by MST with the project-approved Device ID and unchanged firmware state.
required_package: Signed DOCA-Host repo package, runtime/SDK/tools versions, repository metadata/checksums/license and supported host OS/kernel/architecture profile
Reviewed allowlist for numactl, ipmitool, python3-paramiko, python3-prettytable, python3-matplotlib and any justified dependency; `sshpass` excluded unless separately approved
BlueField model/serial/PSID/BDF/slot and expected MST Device ID plus host driver/firmware recipe
Pre/post package/service/network/PCIe state, dependency diff, disk capacity, trusted repository and package rollback plan
Maintenance/OOB access and reboot decision if the pinned host profile explicitly requires it
test_case.test_command: After package, host-compatibility, target and rollback approval, preserve apt/dpkg/package/service/network/PCIe baselines; install only the signed pinned DOCA-Host repository and allowlisted host packages with complete logs; run `mst start` and retain the full `mst status -v` output, bind the result to the approved BlueField identity and compare Device ID/version state to SPEC. Do not deploy a BFB, flash firmware or reboot unless a separate exact authorization covers it.
test_case.expected_result: Every approved host package installs from the trusted pinned repository without unresolved dependency or service/network error; the intended BlueField appears once at the mapped BDF/slot with the signed Device ID and expected host driver/version state; no unapproved package, BFB, firmware or reboot occurs; host/DPU connectivity and platform health remain acceptable.
test_case.pass_fail_basis: PASS requires the immutable package manifest, complete install transcript, pre/post dependency/service state, full target-bound MST output and signed Device ID/version comparison. apt success alone, truncated grep/head output or an unrelated DPU cannot pass; any BFB/firmware result belongs to separate coverage.
safety_gate: Freeze signed repository/package manifest and supported OS/kernel profile; record dependency/service/network changes before install
Maintain independent OOB and network recovery; protect active BlueField interfaces and workloads
Exclude BFB/firmware flash and unapproved reboot from this row; do not install credential tools without a justified approved need
Preserve logs and stop on signature, dependency, service, network, PCIe or target mismatch; no automatic retry
expected_evidence: Repository/package signatures/checksums/license, supported host profile and allowlisted manifest
Host OS/kernel/architecture and BlueField model/serial/PSID/BDF/slot/SPEC identity
Complete apt/dpkg transactions and package/dependency/service/network before/after diff
Full `mst start` and `mst status -v` output with Device ID/version comparison
Proof of no BFB/firmware mutation plus PCIe/network/platform health
Rollback/reboot record if separately approved and engineer verdict
test_case.recovery: On package or dependency failure, stop without repeating apt/dpkg, preserve transaction logs and package state, use OOB if networking is affected, roll back only via the approved repository/package snapshot and verify services/PCIe/MST. Any DPU firmware or BFB recovery is out of scope and requires its own runbook.

source_conflict.reason: Authoritative NVIDIA guidance and the Master distinguish host DOCA packages from BF-Bundle/DPU deployment; DeepSeek's flash/reboot expansion is rejected, leaving a coherent host-install plus MST identity case.

blocked.reason: Host-install semantics, target evidence and rollback are defined; exact signed packages, host profile and Device ID SPEC are execution prerequisites.

pending.unlock_condition: Approve the immutable host package and target/SPEC transaction; any BFB/firmware work remains a separate authorization.
